name: ISINAC AR
summary:
ISINAC AR is the professional tool for ISINAC distributors. Put on the headset in your client's room and design the acoustic treatment on the spot.

WHAT IT DOES
• Scans the real room (walls, floor and ceiling) and measures it.
• Places ISINAC acoustic panels at real scale on walls and ceilings, with real finishes and colours (ILUCS and IZZER ranges).
• Calculates the TR60 reverberation time of the room, before and after treatment, per frequency band.
